slides.title: You stop breathing when it gets hard.
slides.body: Watch the last five reps of any set. Mouth shut, face red, one huge gasp at the end.

slides.title: Bracing is for heavy. Not for 30 reps.
slides.body: Hold your breath for one heavy rep. Hold it through a long set and you blow up early.

slides.title: Exhale on every rep.
slides.body: Thrusters, burpees, box jumps. Out on the effort, in on the way back. Every rep.

slides.title: Rest in your breath, not the clock.
slides.body: Long slow exhales. Three of them beat standing over the bar panting.

slides.title: Set the rhythm in round one.
slides.body: Pick it while it's easy. If you don't have it in round one, it won't show up in round four.
